description:
v1.0 | 7845 gates | 13 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Multiplies a 32-bit number by itself.

Use this circuit wherever a creation has to square a whole number, for example in a calculator or in the arithmetic part of a computer.

It multiplies one unsigned binary number by itself. The square is twice as wide as the input. Input and output are read least significant digit first.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the number = x 0-31.
Outputs (green gates): square = x 0-63.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: Counters of up to 7 bits bring the columns down in few layers, then a fast adder.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits/tree/main/circuits/square
